summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to declare regular monthly distributions for its Class S, D, and I shares for May 2026 (ranging from $0.19506 to $0.21243 per share), report April 30, 2026 NAV per share ($24.79-$25.36) and aggregate NAV ($270.7M), and update continuous offering activity. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of fund distributions, NAV, and offering status.
